newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Central Tarlac lays off over 500 workers.
newsitem.headline: Central Tarlac lays off over 500 workers.

text.p: Philippine sugar miller Central Azucarera de Tarlac said on Friday it has retrenched over 500 workers to survive the slump in the local sugar industry.
The firm operates a 3,000-hectare sugar complex belonging to the family of former President Corazon Aquino.

In a disclosure to the Philippine Stock Exchange, the firm said it had to trim its labour force to remain in business due to the drop in global sugar prices and imports of cheaper sugar into the country in recent months.
"To date, we have served about 520 notices of such kind," Central Azucarera Tarlac said.
Another sugar miller, Victorias Milling Corp and its trading arm North Negros Marketing Corp, have sought a debt moratorium from banks for their combined debts of six billion pesos.
